sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; baked payload is only the fallback (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the Discount % column. R37: optional nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn series — the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Margin columns, dollars exactly as the Summary card's Margin row (negative = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither). The R36 nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys are RETIRED — no Excel column ever carried them. The Trends margin section hides when a payload lacks the keys

june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block (mem absent → byte-identical to R37, verified).

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R39 (2026-07-30): Lost GP / Lost CP replace Erosion on the Summary bucket card. New minutes layer: man-minutes = job elapsed (Start->End of Working Time, 98-100% coverage in every bucket regardless of pay type; the Total Technician Paid Time timesheet field covers only 6-23% and is NOT used) x crew size from Assigned Technicians (100% populated), capped per job at 8h service-side / 12h install because ServiceTitan leaves jobs open for days (worst July service job spanned 99 days, worst install 135). Caps are Stephen's measured reality (service call ~2 crew man-hours, changeout ~17); the uncapped service MEDIAN reproduces 2.0 man-hours exactly. Each technician is classified install-side or service-side by where the majority of their Service+Install minutes went (branch-wide, one pass); a callback/warranty job worked entirely by an install crew inherits the install ceiling. Lost GP/CP price each bucket's minutes at the rate for the side that actually logged them - 76% of July callback hours and 53% of warranty hours were install crews, so blending the rates or excluding install would both be wrong - with scope GP and CP split between the two sides by their share of job-attributed margin, so Lost GP can never exceed earned GP. Card rows: Erosion out; Man-hours, Lost GP, Lost CP in (Service and Install render em-dash, they set the rate). ero/eroP remain computed but unrendered. Summary gains lostGP/lostCP/lostMin; dept gains min/minS/minI/minCut/minImp; computeAll returns winDays. OPPORTUNITY COST, not recoverable cash - real while capacity-constrained, overstates in a slow month; the card note says so. Verified 2026-07-30 jsdom A/B vs R38 (July 07/01-07/29 exports, 3,689 jobs, $5,549,545, gates 6/6 both builds, builtAt equalized): 84 panes across 3 scopes x 4 tabs -> 60 byte-identical, all 24 diffs are deptBody/deptNote and nothing else; RAW byte-identical (1,121,918 chars); zero engine errors both. Reconciliation 9/9: buckets partition all 3,689 jobs, HVAC+Plumb = Branch on jobs and man-hours, implied $/man-hour internally consistent per scope, total Lost GP inside actual GP. Parsers, job-level math, GM/CP, flags, accrual, Handoff, Trends and review machinery untouched. build.js and close.js run VERBATIM.

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)
mem.split: 94% HVAC / 6% Plumbing, applied at ingest into PP_GOALS[trade].mem={rev,cost}
mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37

r39.caps: service-side 480 min/job, install 720 min/job; CB/WT worked entirely by an install crew inherit the install cap
r39.time_source: Job Costing 'Start of Working Time' / 'End of Working Time' x crew count from 'Assigned Technicians'; bucket median backfills the ~2% of jobs with no usable stamps
r39.rate: scope GP (and CP) split between service and install by share of job-attributed margin, divided by that side's man-minutes; lost minutes priced by the side of the tech who logged them
r39.caveat: opportunity cost at current productivity - not recoverable cash
